rule.statement: The burden of proof lies on the party who wishes the court to believe in the existence of a fact, unless it is provided by any law that the proof of the fact shall lie on any particular person.
rule.supporting_quote: Section 103 of the Evidence Ordinance stipulates that “the burden of proof as to any particular fact lies on that person who wishes the court to believe in its existence, unless it is provided by any law that the proof of the fact shall lie on any particular person”.
